page.overview:
Who is Advik?

() is a human man who runs Advik's Wandering Curiosities and Collections in Elder's Post. As an NPC, is played by Matthew Mercer.

Advik is a thin human man with black hair, which he wears side-parted and slicked back into a long ponytail. He has a thin pencil mustache which extends beyond the corners of his mouth, and good posture. When the Bells Hells first met him, he wore a button-down shirt with a weatherbeaten cloak over it.

Advik is somewhat theatrical in his interactions, and tells long anecdotes about how he procured the items he has for sale.

Some time ago, Advik claimed to have walked in the outskirts of the Heartmoor of Oderan Wilds and met a young herbalist named Amarash. After a night of drinks, he began to regale Advik with the tales of his family's great technique in brewing the finest of herbal remedies, which he lost over a game of cards that night.
